
Plots of the PDF for various exponential distributions are given in Fig.\ \@ref(fig:ExponentialDistributions)}.



```{r ExponentialDistributions, echo=FALSE, fig.align="center", fig.cap="Exponential distributions for various values of the rate parameter $\\lambda = 1/\\beta$.",fig.width=4,fig.height=3.5}
x <- seq(0, 10,
         length = 100)

lambda <- c(0.5, 1, 2)

for (i in (1:length(lambda))){
  lambdai <- lambda[i]
  if (i == 1) {
     plot(x = x,
          y = dexp(x,
                   rate = 1/lambda[i]),
          xlab = expression(italic(x)),
          ylab = "Probability function",
          lwd = 2,
          las = 1,
          ylim = c(0, 1.5),
          type = "l",
          main = "Exponential distributions")
  } else {
    lines(x = x,
          y = dexp(x,
                   rate = 1/lambda[i]),
          lty = i,
          lwd = 2)
  }
}

legend( "topright",
        lty = 1:3,
        lwd = 2,
        legend = c(bquote(lambda == 0.5),
                   bquote(lambda == 1),
                   bquote(lambda == 2) )
        )
```
